A formidable fortress guard to begin with, the mastiff can also be trained for war or hunting by a [[Animal_trainer|animal trainer]] and clad in iron or steel at the [[Warbeast_kennel|warbeast kennels]]. A Mastiff is significantly stronger than a [[Dog]], if war-trained, they can easily take down an early opponent.
